a.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance says North Korean hackers used a fake job interview to trick an employee into installing malware that ultimately let them compromise the company's wallet infrastructure and steal about $6.34 billion in digital assets. [...]
a.title: Binance says fake job interview led to $6.3 billion crypto heist

b.lede: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling, and fake job interviews.
b.title: Binance says hackers who stole billions in crypto spent months planning heist
